title: Gomoku AI Pro
description: Challenge a sharp offline Five-in-a-Row AI on a warm wooden Go board—set clever double-three traps, block threats, and connect five stones first.
controls: Tap any empty grid intersection on the board to place your stone and connect five in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

zh-CN.title: AI 五子棋
zh-CN.description: 国民经典对弈 AI 五子棋：离线随时迎战智能电脑棋手，步步布阵活三冲四抢先连成五子一举定胜负！
zh-CN.controls: 点击木质棋盘上的空交叉点落子，率先在横、竖或斜方向连成五颗同色棋子即获胜。
